svg.title: Decoding: Time per call, shorter is faster
svg.text: Decoding: Time per call, shorter is faster
Unmarshal into new-api's request and response types; top-right: the closest competitor ÷ moego/json; each panel has its own scale
Intel Xeon E5-2699A v4 @ 2.40GHz · linux/amd64 · Go 1.27.3 · GOMAXPROCS=1 on one pinned CPU · one process per row and engine, 6 rotated rounds
KVM virtual machine; results apply to this machine only
Claude Messages request with an image
OpenAI Responses request with an image
The time multiplier is the reciprocal of the median of the per-round ratios moego/json ÷ competitor, for the closest competitor.
Outputs were checked before timing: values equal encoding/json's; bytes too, except sonic Default and encoding/json/v2, which do not promise encoding/json's bytes.
Measured with bench/json/codec, drawn by bench/json/codec/plot.py
